name: Observability: HyperDX 2,500-Line Log Memory Leak Root Cause Triage
description: Analyze a high-volume 2,500-line JSON log stream exported from HyperDX / OpenTelemetry. Identify a silent connection pool leak where gRPC keepalive timeouts cause thread exhaustion in microservice auth workers under burst traffic.

claude_code.notes: Token-maxing trap: Claude Code dumps entire 2,500 raw log lines directly into prompt each turn without log filtering.

kobayashi_full.notes: SoL-Pi observation pack stripped 97.4% of repetitive JSON log noise. Spill store offloaded raw dumps to disk. 99.4% cost savings vs Claude Code.
